cases.title: 2002 House District 27
cases.finding: HD27's omission is a SOURCE GAP, not a canonical-builder rule: the legacy 2002 adapter parsed the MARSHALL sheet with the wrong column offset, storing office='MARSHALL' and district NULL, so the rows failed the identity build's office/district filter; the identity build also predates the 2026-09-05 repair that fixed the parse.

raw_cells.sheet_scan: state house district 27 appears on exactly 1 of 67 sheets: MARSHALL (district is Marshall-only in this source)

canonical_layer.note: 2002 house canonical has 155 rows / 104 districts / 51 two-party races; district 27 absent

root_cause.mechanism: scripts/sos_precinct.py::_legacy_2002 at git 7ffd27e3 read title,party,candidate=row[2:5] and paired padded[header_row-1][5:] with row[6:]; correct for the DEKALB offset layout, wrong for the MARSHALL standard layout (county name taken as office, party code as candidate, summary column counted as a precinct).
root_cause.fix: WQA-02 in RUN-40A033B9854141F6B05A76173E66D17B reparsed MARSHALL with the corrected metadata-header adapter (2,950 retained cells).
root_cause.stale_identity_build: canonical_candidate_identity RUN-872E84CE49F34E46A3B71A275F9C8890 dated 2026-09-02 predates the 2026-09-05 repair and was never rerun.
root_cause.canonical_builder_filter: vote_observations WHERE office IN ('State House','State Senate') AND district IS NOT NULL, then resolved_party IN ('D','R') - no multi-county/office-string/district-parse exclusion rule exists.
